question: Under what condition did Śaṅkara choose the goddess as his beloved?
premises: The goddess had become one who had seen menstruation
Śaṅkara chose her at that time
He chose her as his beloved
inference: Śaṅkara chose the goddess as beloved when she was in a menstruating state.
plain_english: When she had become one who had seen menstruation, Śaṅkara chose her as his beloved.
